INSERT INTO attendance_file_vacation( `name`,department,`position`,vacation_type,leave_day,road_day,return_time, start_time,end_time,act_start_time,act_end_time,approval_status,file_id) VALUES
(#{item.name},#{item.department},#{item.position}, #{item.vacationType},#{item.leaveDay}, #{item.roadDay},#{item.returnTime}, #{item.startTime},#{item.endTime}, #{item.actStartTime},#{item.actEndTime},#{item.approvalStatus}, #{item.fileId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE leave_day = VALUES(leave_day), start_time = VALUES(start_time), end_time = VALUES(end_time), approval_status = VALUES(approval_status), file_id = VALUES(file_id), status_cd = '0'

INSERT INTO attendance_file_rest(`name`,department,submit_date,start_time,end_time,rest_duration,approval_status,file_id) VALUES
(#{item.name},#{item.department},#{item.submitDate},#{item.startTime},#{item.endTime}, #{item.restDuration},#{item.approvalStatus},#{item.fileId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submit_date = VALUES(submit_date), rest_duration = VALUES(rest_duration), approval_status = VALUES(approval_status), file_id = VALUES(file_id), status_cd = '0'

INSERT INTO attendance_file_overtime(`name`,department,submit_date,start_time,end_time, work_overtime_duration,work_overtime_matter,approval_status,file_id) VALUES
(#{item.name}, #{item.department}, #{item.submitDate}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.workOvertimeDuration}, #{item.workOvertimeMatter}, #{item.approvalStatus}, #{item.fileId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submit_date = VALUES(submit_date), work_overtime_duration = VALUES(work_overtime_duration), work_overtime_matter = VALUES(work_overtime_matter), approval_status = VALUES(approval_status), file_id = VALUES(file_id), status_cd = '0'
